name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: No red aviation codes found (20 Nov)
summary: No red aviation codes, VEI 4+ eruptions or ash-related airspace closures found by 20 Nov; Kanlaon emitting minor ash
state: Phivolcs kept Kanlaon in the Philippines at alert level 2 after ash emissions up to 900 metres above the crater on 15 and 16 Nov, with ashfall on villages in Negros Occidental and no flight cancellations reported (Nature World News). Mayon remains at alert level 3 after its 30 Oct eruption. Searches on 20 Nov found no red aviation colour code near major air routes, no VEI 4+ eruption and no major ash-related airspace closure, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Air travel is not significantly affected. Travellers near Kanlaon or Mayon in the Philippines should follow Phivolcs and local authority advice on danger zones.
rubric_hit: Normal: no aviation colour code red and no large eruption found; Kanlaon alert level 2, Mayon level 3
